{"path": "create_feature_tables.py", "content": "import hopsworks
import pandas as pd
import os

# Connect to Hopsworks
project = hopsworks.login()
fs = project.get_feature_store()

# Read the raw data
raw_a = pd.read_csv("data/raw_a.csv")
raw_b = pd.read_csv("data/raw_b.csv")

# Create feature groups for raw_a and raw_b
rawa_fg = fs.create_feature_group(
    name="rawa7b4d0b",
    version=1,
    description="Feature group for raw_a.csv",
    primary_key=["row_id"],
    online_enabled=True,
)
rawa_fg.insert(raw_a, write_options={"wait_for_job": True})

rawb_fg = fs.create_feature_group(
    name="rawb7b4d0b",
    version=1,
    description="Feature group for raw_b.csv",
    primary_key=["row_id"],
    online_enabled=True,
)
rawb_fg.insert(raw_b, write_options={"wait_for_job": True})

# Join the two feature groups to create the derived feature group
join_query = rawa_fg.select(["row_id", "a_val"]).join(rawb_fg.select(["row_id", "b_val"]), on="row_id")

# Compute col_sum = a_val + b_val rounded to 6 decimal places
derived_df = join_query.read()
derived_df["col_sum"] = (derived_df["a_val"] + derived_df["b_val"]).round(6)
derived_df = derived_df[["row_id", "col_sum"]]

# Create the derived feature group
derived_fg = fs.create_feature_group(
    name="derived7b4d0b",
    version=1,
    description="Derived feature group from raw_a and raw_b",
    primary_key=["row_id"],
    online_enabled=True,
)
derived_fg.insert(derived_df, write_options={"wait_for_job": True})

# Register lineage
derived_fg.add_tag("derived_from", ["rawa7b4d0b", "rawb7b4d0b"])

# Write the lineage answer to submission/answers.json
answers = {"derived_from": sorted(["rawa7b4d0b", "rawb7b4d0b"])}
import json
with open("submission/answers.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(answers, f)

# Write the derived table to submission/derived7b4d0b.csv
derived_df.to_csv("submission/derived7b4d0b.csv", index=False)"}
